example: The destructive winds caused serious damage to the houses.
exampleZh: 这破坏力极强的风严重损坏了房屋。
extension: de(向下)+struct(建造)+ive(形容词) = 破坏性的

example: Archaeology requires careful analysis and patience.
exampleZh: 考古学研究需要细致的分析和耐心。

example: A thin layer of fog lingers above the river due to evaporation of water.
exampleZh: 由于水分蒸发，河面上仍笼罩着一层薄雾。

example: The app update incorporates many new features and improvements.
exampleZh: 应用更新引入了多项新功能和改进。
extension: in(进入)+corpor(身体)+ate(动词) = 包含

example: Our telescope has made many important astronomical observations.
exampleZh: 我们的望远镜已经取得了许多重要的天文观测成果。
extension: astro(星星)+nomical(学科的) = 天文学的

example: The dictionary gives a clear interpretation to each word.
exampleZh: 词典对每个单词都给出了清晰的释义。
extension: interpret(解释)+ation(名词后缀) = 解释

example: We only had six days of rehearsal.
exampleZh: 我们只有六天的排练时间。

example: I hate to deflate your ego, but you seem to have an exaggerated idea of your importance to me.
exampleZh: 我不愿伤你的自尊，但是你好像高估了你对我的重要性。
extension: de(向下)+flate(吹气) = 泄气/打击

example: You no doubt noticed the ellipsis in the code above.
exampleZh: 您一定注意到上述代码中的省略号。
